top_choice_rationale: P001 recognises a mature, independently confirmed discovery: the Z2 invariant and quantum spin Hall state of time-reversal-invariant insulators (Kane and Mele), with the first experimental observation of the edge transport in HgTe quantum wells (Molenkamp). It is a distinct class of matter from the 2016 topological prize and has spread across several subfields; the three-name allocation is cleanly supported, with the omissions (Hasan, Bernevig, Hughes, Zhang) acknowledged and handled by a citation confined to the 2D state. P002 (optical lattice clocks, Katori and Ye) is a serious, mature and cleanly attributed invention, but narrower in reach and I cannot test its priority against the comb and ion-clock prizes as a non-specialist, so it ranks second; an award in some form is preferable to none.
